name: codex-auto-retry
description: Automatically resumes Codex tasks after recoverable provider failures, with an embedded status and settings panel.

interface.shortDescription: Recover interrupted tasks and manage retries inside Codex.
interface.longDescription: Runs a local, provider-independent watchdog that retries failed tasks through Codex App's own background connection without focusing the App or switching tasks. An embedded panel shows live countdowns and queue state, and lets you pause retries or change the normal-conversation retry text.
defaultPrompt: 打开 Codex Auto Retry 管理面板。
查看自动重试队列和倒计时。
把普通对话的重试文字改成“继续”。
